answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable coin bond before its answer is accepted: pass peer review and the bond returns with a reward, but let the jury rule the answer fraudulent and the whole bond burns on-ledger. Standing is never gifted at signup, it is a willow rooted in capital at risk. A Sybil spinning 1,000 clones must post 1,000 SEPARATE bonds, so a gale of fakes each forfeits its own stake on rejection and a bondless sparrow of a key carries zero weight. Attacker cost is strictly linear per head: 1,000 identities equal 1,000 bonds lost when slashed, no shared reserve to amortize.
